milestone: Owned n-ary operand lists for fused Apple GPU maps
implementation: Resident graph map descriptors optionally carry sorted unique source spans; existing binary descriptors and two-input matrix products remain valid
Capture validates map-only operand lists, anchors, indices, complete shapes/ranks, residency and shader signatures before scheduling GPU work
Operand spans are copied into budgeted graph-owned storage and rebound before asynchronous submission; graph value copying is disabled to preserve internal span ownership
Use counts and last-use reclamation include every explicit source; checked retention rejects overflow; broadcast slots follow the complete tensor operand list
Compiler lane analysis emits explicit source lists beyond two, includes non-anchor sources in graph liveness and retains existing checked shape proofs and resource interfaces
Operand analysis is bounded by compiler work budgets rather than a fixed two-source cap; the native stack and device/capture resource budgets are unchanged

qualification.reference: LLVM APFloat separately rounded arithmetic and ordered comparisons; balanced reduction reference; exact bits except NaNs compared by classification
cases: Independent source vectors of lengths 0, 1, 3, 7, 65 and 257 across six IEEE/cancellation/random patterns and eight scalar encodings; nested direct choices and a four-command resident reduction graph
Submission clobbers and destroys the caller operand arrays before execution; graph-owned copies retain valid bindings in every numerical/failure case
Malformed duplicate, unordered, bad-anchor, missing-source/signature and future-reference lists, a mismatched middle tensor and a host-resident middle tensor fail before a GPU submission
Every permitted allocation checkpoint plus cancellation, deadline or device failure at all four commands preserves buffer, task and argument accounting

Ten CLI scenarios with 1/2/4 workers in four modes: vector/matrix choices, false and constant arms, empty tensors, retained middle intermediates, a map feeding two products, dynamic middle Shape faults, a 40-source resident map and relocated output
Fixed-source CLI regression now treats the formerly rejected three-source choice as a positive executable probe
Product-only graphs, arithmetic graphs, multiple reductions, tensor feedback and checked dynamic choices retain sanitizer qualification
Installed Release compiler and matching runtime/header bundle build the n-ary graph; relocated applications run independently after source/compiler resources are removed
qualification.release_package: native-metal-package built; Release native-metal-install passed (68.61 seconds)

remaining: Single-matmul operand-map admission for different-source choices
Unproven independent shapes, differently shaped outputs and conditional numerical primitive stages
Wider GPU numeric types and broader ranks
Optimization: deep linear tensor-choice chains scale pathologically in CPU-shadow MLIR One-Shot Bufferize alias analysis; tracked in docs/roadmap.md
compile_time_scope: The forty-source qualified case is one choice over two elementwise expressions with a resident sum predicate. A separate deeply nested forty-leaf dynamic choice exposed slow CPU-shadow bufferization and is not claimed qualified; native stack admission was not relaxed.
